rulings.model: The form asks for 'Rental real estate, royalties, partnerships, S corporations, trusts, etc. (submit copy of federal Schedule E)'. The program always enters $0, and no refusal names Schedule E income.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; the line is zero because the federal return it copies cannot hold Schedule E income: this tool refuses it on the federal return (scope.schedule1, "Any income or adjustment requiring Schedule 1 other than the ones this tool asks about separately"; the federal encoding has no Schedule 1 line 5 ("Rental real estate, royalties, partnerships, S corporations, trusts, etc. Attach Schedule E"); f1040s1 p. 1), and the New York return is computed only from a computed federal return. The rendering's note says so. Not a defect.

rulings.model: The form asks for 'Rental real estate included in line 11'. This is fixed at $0 with no refusal for rental income, so it is wrong whenever line 11 should include rental real estate.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; line 12 is the rental real estate included in line 11, and line 11 is always zero because the federal return refuses Schedule E (scope.schedule1; no federal Schedule 1 line 5), so line 12 is zero too. Not a defect.
